title: IVG Smart Max Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The IVG Smart Max Bundle combines intelligent design with exceptional value, offering a complete setup for vapers who demand performance and convenience. This exclusive package includes two complete IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kits plus an additional IVG Smart Max Refill Pod. With two devices and extra e-liquid included, you can enjoy extended vaping sessions without interruption, keep a backup device ready, or switch between flavours effortlessly. Each Smart Max kit is built around a powerful 1000mAh rechargeable battery and features a clear digital display. Uniquely, the device offers two distinct performance modes: Eco Mode for everyday efficiency, and Boost Mode for a fuller, more intense vape. The system uses an integrated 10ml refill reservoir that automatically feeds the 2ml pod, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit without the need for manual refilling. Optimised for a smooth Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience, the Smart Max delivers consistent flavour and discreet vapour with minimal fuss. Available Bundle Flavours: The bundle grants access to IVG’s expertly blended flavour range. Options include the cool and refreshing Polar Mint, the nostalgic soda-inspired Retro Orange, and vibrant fruit mixes like Tropical Fruits and Frozen Watermelon. Whether you prefer zesty citrus like Lemon and Lime or the sweet chill of Banana Ice, there is a profile to suit every taste. How To Set Up Your IVG Smart Max Device Step 1 Remove the device and refill components from the packaging. Step 2 Insert the 10ml refill reservoir into the device as instructed. Step 3 Click the 2ml pod into place. Step 4 Allow the system to prime for a moment. Step 5 Inhale to vape (auto-draw). Step 6 Double-tap the button (if applicable) or refer to the manual to switch between Eco and Boost modes. ✅ Ready to vape
